fields.statement: ArgentSea.Pg.csproj declares Npgsql as the only database-platform client dependency among its direct PackageReference and ProjectReference items: it carries no SqlClient or Microsoft.Data.SqlClient package reference, and no project or package reference to ArgentSea.Sql. Its complete set of non-core direct references is Npgsql, Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration, Microsoft.Extensions.Logging, and a single ProjectReference to the shared ArgentSea core (ArgentSea.Shared).
fields.scope: The PackageReference and ProjectReference items declared directly in ArgentSea.Pg.csproj — ArgentSea.Pg's own, non-transitive dependency declarations. This does not characterize dependencies pulled in transitively through ArgentSea.Shared or the listed packages, which the csproj does not show.
